messages:
mira: Quick FYI — I opened a branch `feature/staging-canary-ttl` that adjusts service-router TTL from 30s -> 10s for staging and renames secret paths (secrets/service-router -> secrets/sr). Planning a short canary (30m). Asking for a quick config review + gate so we can promote later today.
jon: i skimmed the TF diff, looks straightforward. main concern is the secret path rename — do we have a migration or alias in place?
sasha: agree with jon. If we rename without write-path compatibility, pods may fail on restart. any plan to add a compat wrapper in kube secret-sync?
mira: good call — included a tiny compatibility job in the branch to copy old secret to new path during rollout. it's idempotent and only enabled for the canary. snippet:```hcl
resource "null_resource" "sr_secret_alias" {
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<EOT
kubectl -n staging get secret service-router -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - -n staging --dry-run=server
# then patch name -> sr
EOT
  }
}
```
jon: can you paste the exact k8s patch? easier to reason about the rename if we see it.
mira: sure:```yaml
# kubectl patch to duplicate secret under new name
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: sr
  namespace: staging
stringData:
  # copy relevant fields from existing secret via job
```
(we run it only in canary namespace)
sasha: thanks. also, Terraform plan shows provider-level change to backend bucket lifecycle — is that intended? I see:```diff
~ resource "aws_s3_bucket" "tfstate" {
+  lifecycle_rule {
+    id      = "expire-old-states"
+    enabled = true
+    expiration { days = 365 }
+  }
}
```
sasha: is this going to affect other envs?
mira: no, it's scoped to `staging-tfstate` workspace in the branch. I've kept prod unchanged. will only apply after canary validation.
infra-bot: PLAN COMPLETED — 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy. See plan log: https://ci.redwood/plan/1716669999 :eyes:
j0n (typo): :eyes:
jon: minor nit — update README in the overlay dir to document the temporary alias job and canary window. Otherwise LGTM.
mira: done, pushed README update. Also added a canary label for routing:```yaml
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        rollout: canary-ttl-10s
```
oliver: quick question — what happens to live traffic if the service-router pods restart during secret copy?
mira: no downtime expected: the alias job copies secret into new name, we then perform a rolling restart on deployments, but readiness probes keep old pods serving until new ones are ready. TTL reduction should lower re-establishment times but not drop connections due to readiness gating.
sasha: can we add a short smoke test in CI that calls `/healthz` and verifies route table for 200 after restart? if so I'm happy to approve the gate.
mira: adding a smoke test now to the pipeline; will kick CI, then request gate approval.
jon: +1 to smoke test. if CI passes, i'm comfortable with canary.
oliver: +1 from me as well.
infra-bot: GATE REQUESTED by mira. reviewers: jon, sasha, oliver. status: pending CI and manual ack.
mira: CI passed for the smoke test. rolling canary window starts in 5min. please react with :thumbsup: when you ack.
jon: :+1:
sasha: :+1:
oliver: :+1:
